messages:
sam: Heads-up — planning to push release v2.3.1 to prod tonight at 02:00 UTC. Rolling deploy, 10% canary for 15m then ramp if green. pinging owners for rollback readiness.
anya: 👍 I'll own smoke checks and metrics during canary. Which alerts should I watch?
sam: @anya main ones: 5xx rate, request latency p50/p95, KV cache hit rate, and inference queue depth. Thresholds in the runbook snippet below.
maria: Adding CPU/GPU contention + OOMs to that list. Also confirm quantization variant fallback is wired.
jason: I validated the fallback in staging yesterday — model-quantized-v2 fallback works. I can run a quick dry-run of the rollback command beforehand.
sam: Please do the dry-run, @jason. Attach the exact commands used for rollback in the thread.
jason: Dry-run notes: used deploy tool --stage canary --rollback-to tag=v2.3.0, no destructive actions. Command:
```
redwood-deploy rollback --env=prod --selector=service=runtime --to-tag=v2.3.0 --force-checks
```
I confirmed it only toggles the route weights without touching DB.
anya: Nice. Runbook excerpt (condensed):
- Go/no-go window: first 15m canary.
- Abort if: 5xx >= 0.5% over window OR p95 latency +50% vs baseline OR KV hit < 60% OR error spike in model calls.
- Rollback steps: notify #incidents, run rollback command, monitor canary window, escalate to oncall if rollback fails.
- Postmortem: must include prompt/traffic split and token cost delta.
sam: Who's oncall at 02:00 UTC? We need an explicit handoff.
maria: @devops-bot show oncall for 2026-03-01T02:00Z
devops-bot: Oncall for 2026-03-01 00:00-08:00 UTC -> oncall: jason (primary), anya (backup)
sam: Great — @jason you'll be primary for escalations, @anya you'll handle metrics and smoke. I'll run the deploy and stay on Slack for the window.
jason: Confirmed. I'll be reachable by phone too. If rollback happens, I'll run the rollback command and follow the runbook checklist.
anya: I'll prepare the Grafana dashboard short-links and keep a quick runbook snippet pinned. Also will run the smoke test script once canary finishes:
```
./scripts/smoke_check.sh --env=prod --route=canary
```
sam: Pre-deploy checklist (done / owner):
- Build artifact uploaded -> sam (done)
- Canary config set (10% -> 50% ramp plan) -> sam (done)
- Healthchecks in place -> jason (done)
- Rollback dry-run -> jason (done)
- Observability links -> anya (in progress)
- Stakeholders notified -> sam (done)
maria: One more: confirm DB migrations not included.
sam: No migrations in this release. Safe.
anya: I'll post the two dashboard links and the smoke script output channel before deploy.
sam: Final go/no-go call at 01:50 UTC. If no objections, proceeding with canary at 02:00 UTC. Reply with "go" or "no-go".
jason: go
maria: go
anya: go — will announce when dashboards are up.
sam: thanks all. I'll start the rollout and tag this thread with deploy logs. If we hit abort criteria, I'll run the rollback command and call out in #incidents.
devops-bot: Deploy started: v2.3.1 -> prod, canary=10%. tracking_id=deploy-1769456789
anya: dashboards posted: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/canary-summary and https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/def456/latency-trends
sam: canary healthy at +10m: p95 within 10% of baseline, 5xx=0.03% (below threshold). ramping to 50% now.
jason: keep watching queue depth and model errors — I'm monitoring logs.
maria: GPU utilization stable. no OOMs.
anya: smoke script passed on a sample of 200 requests, no model errors.
sam: ramp complete. will observe for remaining 5m then finish.
jason: if anything goes sideways, use the rollback command above and ping #incidents.
anya: all green at end of window. marking as successful.
sam: Rollout complete. Post-deploy tasks: update release ticket, schedule brief retro if any small regressions appear. Thanks team. :tada:
